description: Public, read-only details for a named senior living facility or its stable publicId, without a CareOpenly account. Relevant to questions about a specific community's care types, published starting and care-specific prices, floor plans, room types, reviews, amenities, services, coverage evidence, licensing, and inspections. Name lookup identifies the matched facility and reports unresolved ambiguity. Available records include sources and dates; missing fields remain unavailable. Prices are observations rather than quotes, and coverage records do not determine individual benefits. Results include a CareOpenly link for requesting information.

city.description: City mentioned by the user, to improve name matching.

include.description: Extra structured sections relevant to the user's question. Core price, floor plan, and review summaries are always returned.

name.description: Facility name when its publicId is unavailable.

publicId.description: Stable facility ID from a search result.

stateCode.description: Two-letter state code mentioned by the user, to improve name matching.

name: get_facility
title: Get CareOpenly facility details
